verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a hosted REST API for running AI-powered browser tasks (smooth-docs-20, smooth-docs-13). Results are retrieved by polling, which the docs explicitly choose over webhooks (smooth-docs-36). Task list and cancel endpoints are also documented (smooth-docs-37, smooth-docs-38), and community comments confirm the browser runs off the user's machines (smooth-comm-11). Polling alone satisfies the story's 'polling or webhook' requirement. missing for 10: webhook delivery as an alternative, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of the HTTP API flow.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can submit a browser task over a hosted HTTP API and receive the result by polling or webhook, without managing any browser myself

citations.quote: The Smooth API enables programmatic browser automation through REST endpoints. You can run AI-powered tasks
The API uses polling rather than webhooks or WebSockets
given that it's not running on our machines
